explanations.detail: Human ability-bonus selection (choice:human_ability_bonus -> ability:strength) applies the PF1 Core Rulebook Standard Human +2 racial bonus to strength BEFORE ability modifiers are derived: base chosen score 17 + 2 racial = 19. This differs from Dwarf/Half-Elf/etc., whose fixtures pre-bake their own racial adjustment into the chosen score itself (no arithmetic performed on those seams); Human's chosen score is confirmed PRE-bonus by both the deterministic pilot fixture and the real PCGen oracle output.
strength ability modifier from chosen score 19: floor(19 / 2) - 5 = 4
dexterity ability modifier from chosen score 13: floor(13 / 2) - 5 = 1
constitution ability modifier from chosen score 14: floor(14 / 2) - 5 = 2
intelligence ability modifier from chosen score 14: floor(14 / 2) - 5 = 2
wisdom ability modifier from chosen score 12: floor(12 / 2) - 5 = 1
charisma ability modifier from chosen score 8: floor(8 / 2) - 5 = -1
Fighter level 3 base attack bonus = 3
Fighter level 3 base Fortitude save = 3
Fighter level 3 base Reflex save = 1
Fighter level 3 base Will save = 1

Baseline melee attack bonus for the Longsword: Fighter base attack bonus (+3) + Strength modifier (+4) + Weapon Focus (Longsword) (+1) + Medium size modifier (+0, PF1 Table 8-1 -- attack rolls take the same size modifier as Armor Class); Power Attack is selected but inactive (+0) = 8

Baseline armor class: base 10 + Chain Shirt armor bonus (+4) + Dexterity contribution (+1, DEX modifier +1 within MAXDEX:5) + Medium size modifier (+0, PF1 Table 8-1) + Dodge (+1, only for a character actually carrying feat:dodge) + Barbarian Rage penalty (0, only while actively, validly raging) + Skald Inspired Rage penalty (0, only while actively, validly singing) + Bloodrager Bloodrage penalty (0, only while actively, validly bloodraging) + Brawler AC Bonus (+0, while wearing light or no armor) + Alchemist Mutagen natural armor bonus (+0, only while actively, validly mutated) + Inquisitor Protection judgment sacred/profane bonus (+0, only while actively, validly judging Protection) + Oracle Nature's Whispers Charisma-for-Dexterity substitution (+0, only for a Nature-Mystery Oracle who took that revelation) + Cavalier Challenge penalty (0, only while actively challenging) + Sorcerer Draconic Bloodline Dragon Resistances natural armor bonus (+0, only for a Draconic-bloodline Sorcerer at 3rd level or higher) + ARG Armor of the Pit natural armor bonus (+0, only for a character holding that feat who did NOT take the Scaled Skin alternate racial trait); shield is absent (+0) = 16

Touch armor class: the armor class above (16) with the contributors a touch attack ignores removed -- Chain Shirt armor bonus (-4), Alchemist Mutagen natural armor (-0), Sorcerer Draconic Bloodline natural armor (-0), ARG Armor of the Pit natural armor (-0); shield is absent (-0). The Dexterity contribution (+1), the Medium size modifier (+0, PF1 Table 8-1) and every dodge/sacred/ability bonus and penalty are all retained = 12

Flat-footed armor class: the armor class above (16) with the contributors a flat-footed character is denied removed -- the Dexterity contribution (-1, bonus only; a Dexterity penalty is kept) including the Oracle Nature's Whispers Charisma-for-Dexterity substitution (-0, which stands in for that bonus), and every dodge-typed bonus (-1: Dodge's +1, per PF1 "any situation that denies you your Dexterity bonus to Armor Class also denies you dodge bonuses"). The Chain Shirt armor bonus (+4), the Medium size modifier (+0), every natural armor and sacred/profane bonus, every penalty, and Brawler's AC Bonus (+0, whose own rule text applies it even when flat-footed) are all retained = 14

Combat Maneuver Bonus: Fighter base attack bonus (+3) + Strength modifier (+4) + Medium special size modifier (+0) = 7. The special size modifier runs OPPOSITE to Table 8-1's Armor Class column: being smaller makes a creature worse at combat maneuvers, not better. No Improved/Greater maneuver feat or size-changing effect is modelled by this engine, so none is summed here

Combat Maneuver Defense: base 10 + Fighter base attack bonus (+3) + Strength modifier (+4) + Dexterity modifier (+1) + Medium special size modifier (+0) = 18. These are exactly the terms PF1's published CMD formula prints; the deflection/dodge/insight/luck/morale/profane/sacred bonuses to Armor Class that also apply to CMD in real PF1 are NOT folded in here yet, and are named rather than silently implied

Attack bonus with the equipped Longsword: base attack bonus (+3) + governing ability modifier (+4) + weapon feats (+1) + nonproficiency penalty (0) + size modifier (+0) = 8. Weapon Focus / Greater Weapon Focus name this weapon, adding +1 to the attack roll. The character is proficient with this weapon (class grant or a Simple/Martial/Exotic Weapon Proficiency feat naming it), so no nonproficiency penalty applies. Only the Focus feats reach this total -- the Specialization feats are damage and Improved Critical is threat range, both grounded separately. Separate from combat.baseline_melee_attack_bonus, which stays a Longsword-specific GE-06 fixture total until task #80 generalises it

Feat damage bonus with the equipped Longsword: +0. No Weapon Specialization or Greater Weapon Specialization names this weapon, so no feat bonus applies to its damage rolls. This is the feat contribution alone, NOT a damage total: the weapon's own 1d8 damage die and the Strength-to-damage contribution are excluded, because Strength applies at 1x one-handed, 1.5x two-handed and 0.5x off-hand and this engine does not record how a weapon is being wielded

Critical threat range with the equipped Longsword: 19-20/x2. Improved Critical does not name this weapon, so its threat range is the weapon's printed one. The value grounded here is the LOW end of the range; the corpus stores CRITRANGE as a width, so the range is 21-width..=20

Total Fortitude save: Fighter base Fortitude save (+3) + Constitution modifier (+2) + feat bonus (+0, Great Fortitude if selected) + Good domain Touch of Good sacred bonus (+0, self-applied) + Inquisitor Purity judgment sacred/profane bonus (+0, only while actively, validly judging Purity) + alternate racial trait (+0, only for a character who took one that declares a Fortitude bonus) + character trait (+0, Life of Toil if selected) = 5

Total Reflex save: Fighter base Reflex save (+1) + Dexterity modifier (+1) + feat bonus (+0, Lightning Reflexes if selected) + Good domain Touch of Good sacred bonus (+0, self-applied) + Inquisitor Purity judgment sacred/profane bonus (+0, only while actively, validly judging Purity) + Oracle Sidestep Secret Charisma-for-Dexterity substitution (+0, only for a Lore-Mystery Oracle who took that revelation) + alternate racial trait (+0, only for a character who took one that declares a Reflex modifier -- this one can be NEGATIVE, e.g. Horror Adventures' Half-Elf Mismatched at -2) + character trait (+0, no ultimate_campaign trait currently declares a Reflex bonus, so always 0) = 2

Total Will save: Fighter base Will save (+1) + Wisdom modifier (+1) + feat bonus (+0, Iron Will if selected) + Barbarian Rage morale bonus (+0, only while actively, validly raging) + Skald Inspired Rage morale bonus (+0, only while actively, validly singing) + Bloodrager Bloodrage morale bonus (+0, only while actively, validly bloodraging) + Good domain Touch of Good sacred bonus (+0, self-applied) + Inquisitor Purity judgment sacred/profane bonus (+0, only while actively, validly judging Purity) + alternate racial trait (+0, only for a character who took one that declares a Will bonus -- ARG p.42's Half-Elf Dual Minded is the one such trait in the corpus today) + character trait (+0, Indomitable Faith if selected) = 2

Selected Climb modifier: rank 1 + Strength modifier (+4) + class-skill bonus (+3) + Chain Shirt armor-check penalty (-1, reduced from -2 by Fighter armor training) + feat bonus (+0, Athletic if selected) = 7
Selected Intimidate modifier: rank 1 + Charisma modifier (-1) + class-skill bonus (+3) + feat bonus (+0, Persuasive and/or Intimidating Prowess if selected) = 3

Selected Swim modifier: rank 1 + Strength modifier (+4) + class-skill bonus (+3) + Chain Shirt armor-check penalty (-1, reduced from -2 by Fighter armor training) + feat bonus (+0, Athletic if selected) + Witch Flight hex (+0) = 7

Weapon Focus (longsword) grants a +1 bonus on attack rolls with that weapon (+2 when Greater Weapon Focus names it too). This bonus is also carried inside combat.weapon_attack_bonus.<weapon> whenever that weapon is equipped; this record is the component fact, that one is the total, and the two agreeing is expected rather than a double-count. It still grounds standalone, because the feat's bonus is real whether or not the chosen weapon happens to be equipped. Requires an explicit recorded weapon choice -- nothing is seeded, per the same no-silent-seeding design as Skill Focus

Fighter level 2 Bravery (cr_abilities_class.lst Fighter; +1 at level 2 and another +1 every 4 Fighter levels thereafter): grants +1 to Will saves against fear. This is a flat, non-fabricated bonus magnitude only — no fear-condition or Will-save-resolution engine exists anywhere in this codebase, so this bonus is never folded into the unconditional Will save total

Fighter level 3 Armor Training 1 (armor training, cr_abilities_class.lst Fighter): reduces the worn Chain Shirt armor-check penalty by 1 (from -2 to -1) and raises the maximum Dexterity bonus by 1 (from 4 to 5)

Fighter Weapon and Armor Proficiency (corpus KEY:Fighter ~ Weapon and Armor Proficiency): "A fighter is proficient with all simple and martial weapons and with all armor (heavy, medium, and light) and shields (including tower shields)." This is a bounded grant-only identity record (value 0, non-fabricated): the record grants proficiencies automatically and carries no magnitude anywhere. The weapon half's real mechanical consequence -- avoiding the -4 nonproficiency attack penalty -- is already grounded separately by `weapon_tables::class_weapon_proficiency`, which this record does not duplicate. No armor-nonproficiency-penalty mechanic exists anywhere in this engine (the game system's own miscinfo.lst carries only WEAPONNONPROFPENALTY:-4, no armor equivalent), so the armor half has nothing further to compute here

Human ability-bonus selection (choice:human_ability_bonus -> ability:strength) targets strength; the racial-bonus-adjusted strength score (base chosen score + the +2 Human racial bonus, applied before ability modifiers were derived) yields modifier +4
Human bonus-feat selection (choice:human_bonus_feat -> feat:dodge) grants Dodge, the deterministic Dodge feat contributing +1 to the baseline armor class

Human racial trait bundle — size: PF1 Standard Human is Medium size (cr_races.lst race:human SIZE:MEDIUM). This is a bounded recognition record naming the Human size category on the deterministic pilot seam; it contributes no numeric effect to attack rolls, AC, skill checks, ability checks, or any other computed value, so it carries no fabricated mechanical value (+0)

Human racial trait bundle — speed: PF1 Standard Human has a base land speed of 30 ft (cr_races.lst race:human GAIT:WALK|30). This is a grounded recognition value carrying the human base-speed identity on the deterministic pilot seam; it contributes no computed speed-derived effect to any chassis output, skill modifier, attack roll, or combat baseline

Human racial trait bundle — senses: PF1 Standard Human grants no special senses (cr_races.lst race:human carries no SENSE tag for Standard Human; darkvision, low-light vision, scent, and other sense bonuses are absent). This is a bounded no-effect classification record on the deterministic pilot seam; it carries no fabricated sense bonus and contributes no computed value (+0)

Human racial trait bundle — extra skill ranks: PF1 Standard Human gains 4 extra skill points at 1st level and 1 extra skill rank per additional level thereafter (cr_races.lst race:human). The recognition value (+1) carries the per-additional-level extra-rank identity on the deterministic pilot seam; this slice does not propagate these extra skill points/rank through the bounded Climb/Intimidate/Swim rank-1 selected skill-modifier computation, so the bounded fighter-posture skill totals remain grounded by the canonical rank-1 posture rather than by the unbounded Human extra skill-rank rule

class:fighter 3 skill points 12: 2 skill ranks per level + Intelligence modifier (+2), at least 1, times 3 level(s) (core_rulebook:class:fighter); class term only -- racial and favored-class ranks are not the class's

fighter level 3: `Fighter ~ Bonus Feats` ("Bonus Feats") is a class feature of this character, granted from class level 1, per a grant fact ingested from PCGen's own class-progression tokens (data/class_feature_grants). The record's real rulebook description is served separately by the character sheet's Class Features section.

sheetLines.label: Fighter
sheetLines.prose:
Hit die: d10
Skill ranks per level: 2

sheetLines.label: Armor Training (armor training choice picks)
sheetLines.prose:
You are more maneuverable while wearing armor. Whenever you are wearing armor, you reduce the armor check penalty by 1 and increase the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by your armor by +1
Unencumbered movement: MediumArmor

sheetLines.label: Bonus Feats (fighter bonus feat picks)
sheetLines.prose: At 1st level, and at every even level thereafter, a fighter gains a bonus feat in addition to those gained from normal advancement (meaning that the fighter gains a feat at every level). These bonus feats must be selected from those listed as combat feats, sometimes also called "fighter bonus feats." Upon reaching 4th level, and every four levels thereafter (8th, 12th, and so on), a fighter can choose to learn a new bonus feat in place of a bonus feat he has already learned. In effect, the fighter loses the bonus feat in exchange for the new one. The old feat cannot be one that was used as a prerequisite for another feat, prestige class, or other ability. A fighter can only change one feat at any given level and must choose whether or not to swap the feat at the time he gains a new bonus feat for the level.

sheetLines.label: Bravery
sheetLines.prose:
You gain a +1 bonus to Will saves against fear effects.
SaveBonus: +1 Will vs. fear

sheetLines.label: Chain Shirt
sheetLines.prose:
Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.
Armor check penalty: -2
Max Dex bonus: 4
Arcane spell failure: 20%

sheetLines.label: Longsword
sheetLines.prose:
This sword is about 3-1/2 feet in length.
Critical multiplier: x2
Critical threat: 19-20

sheetLines.label: Dodge
sheetLines.prose:
Your training and reflexes allow you to react swiftly to avoid an opponent's attack.
You gain a +1 dodge bonus to your AC. A condition that makes you lose your Dex bonus to AC also makes you lose the benefits of this feat.

sheetLines.label: Power Attack
sheetLines.prose:
You can make exceptionally deadly melee attacks by sacrificing accuracy for strength.
You can choose to take a -1 penalty on all melee attack rolls and combat maneuver checks to gain a +2 bonus on all melee damage rolls. This bonus to damage is increased by half (+50%) if you are making an attack with a two-handed weapon, a one handed weapon using two hands, or a primary natural weapon that adds 1-1/2 times your Strength modifier on damage rolls. This bonus to damage is halved (-50%) if you are making an attack with an off-hand weapon or secondary natural weapon. You must choose to use this feat before making an attack roll, and its effects last until your next turn. The bonus damage does not apply to touch attacks or effects that do not deal hit point damage.

sheetLines.label: Weapon Focus
sheetLines.prose:
You are especially good at using your chosen weapon.
You gain a +1 bonus on all attack rolls you make using the selected weapon.
